title: PrepareRI High School Summer Internship Program
who_text: Rhode Island high school juniors at a public or charter school (or homeschooled), at least 16 years old, who live in Rhode Island and can work in the U.S.
description: A paid summer internship with a Rhode Island employer for rising seniors. It starts with a one-week paid work-readiness bootcamp, then at least 150 hours of work over six weeks. It is free for students.

title: Real Skills for Youth
pay_text: $16.00 per hour at some partner programs
who_text: Rhode Island youth, mostly ages 14 to 24; each partner program sets its own age range
description: A state-funded program that connects young people to paid work experience and career exploration through 29 partner organizations across Rhode Island. You pick a partner program from the state's yearly list and apply to it directly.
